system.name: DecDEC
system.one_liner: a CPU-augmented inference system for quantized LLMs that performs decoding with dynamic error compensation fetched from CPU memory

content.subject: how DecDEC's tuner searches n_tb then k_chunk per layer, step by step, to hit a 10% target slowdown on a 56-SM GPU

elements.name: Phase 1. Determine n_tb (or n_tb^max)
elements.role: first stage: search for the single metaparameter capping thread blocks per layer

elements.name: Phase 2. Determine k_chunk
elements.role: second stage: fine-tune each layer's shared-memory chunk size given the chosen n_tb^max

elements.name: Coarse-grained k_chunk Search
elements.role: for one candidate n_tb^max, finds how many uniform k_chunk increments fit under the target slowdown

elements.name: Fine-grained k_chunk Search
elements.role: refines k_chunk per layer individually once the best n_tb^max is chosen

elements.name: Result
elements.role: final tuned n_tb and k_chunk values per linear-layer type

elements.name: QKV proj
elements.role: the QKV projection layer's k_chunk and latency track through the search steps

elements.name: Output proj
elements.role: the output projection layer's k_chunk/latency track

elements.name: Gate/Up proj
elements.role: the gate/up projection layer's k_chunk/latency track

elements.name: Down proj
elements.role: the down projection layer's k_chunk/latency track

elements.name: Sum
elements.role: total latency across all four layers at each step, compared against the target slowdown to accept or reject that step

elements.name: Step
elements.role: column header indexing successive k_chunk increments, from Step 0 (baseline) upward

relations.what: each candidate n_tb^max is evaluated by its own coarse-grained search
the n_tb^max with the most valid steps is passed on
runs the fine-grained search for the chosen n_tb^max
produces the final per-layer n_tb and k_chunk values
the running total is checked against the target slowdown at every step to decide whether to accept it

panels.label: (a) Phase 1 & 2 overview
panels.differs: runs a coarse-grained k_chunk search for every candidate n_tb^max (1..28) and picks the one allowing the most steps, then hands it to a fine-grained k_chunk search

panels.label: (b) Coarse-grained k_chunk search (n_tb^max = 24)
panels.differs: increments k_chunk by a uniform amount for all four layers together at each step, until the summed latency exceeds the target slowdown at Step 20

panels.label: (c) Fine-grained k_chunk search (n_tb^max = 24)
panels.differs: at each step increments k_chunk for as many individual layers as possible, prioritizing the smallest latency increase (numbered ①②③④)

values.what: per-layer k_chunk and latency numbers at each search step, for both the coarse-grained (uniform, Step 0-20) and fine-grained (per-layer, Step 0-11) k_chunk search
values.linked_by: position, the same four layer rows (QKV/Output/Gate-Up/Down proj) recur in every step column, with circled numbers marking which layer is incremented first in the fine-grained search
values.result_cells: a checkmark/cross above each step marks whether that step's summed latency stays within the target slowdown, and the final 'Result' panel lists the chosen n_tb and k_chunk per layer

content.key_idea: A coarse, uniform-across-layers k_chunk search first picks the best n_tb^max by counting how many steps fit under the target slowdown, then a fine-grained per-layer search refines k_chunk further.
content.reading_order: (a) top: overview of the two search phases across n_tb^max candidates; (b) bottom-left: the coarse search table; (c) bottom-right: the zoomed-in fine-grained table

style.stroke: ~0.6pt black table borders, with gray rules separating header bands
style.arrows: many thin straight black lines forming the table grids and a few arrows chaining Phase 1 to Phase 2 to Result, plus dashed zoom-callout lines from Step 19 in (b) into (c)

encoding.color_means: gray header bars label 'Phase 1' / 'Phase 2' / 'Result'; gold/amber highlights the specific cell(s) incremented at the current step in the fine-grained search
encoding.line_style_means: solid black grid lines rule every table; dashed lines zoom-callout from the coarse table's Step 19 into the fine-grained table (c)
encoding.state_means: each step column is a frame of the same per-layer table, so a layer's state (its current k_chunk and latency) is read by column position, not by colour
encoding.marker_means: checkmarks/crosses mark whether a step's total latency is still within the target slowdown; circled numbers ①②③④ order which layer is incremented first within a fine-grained step
encoding.emphasis: the gold highlight and circled order-numbers single out exactly which layer's k_chunk changes at each individual fine-grained step, versus the coarse table where all four change together
reusable_patterns: a per-layer table replayed step by step with a running Sum row and a checkmark/cross verdict against a fixed target, zoomed from a coarse uniform version into a fine per-layer version
weaknesses: extremely dense (335 text runs across a double-column figure) with many small ~4.5pt numbers, making the coarse-to-fine zoom relationship hard to trace precisely

evidence: Phase 1 determines the ntb values, and Phase 2 determines the kchunk values
the GPU has 56 SMs, so values up to 28 are tested
the tuner increments kchunk for as many layers as possible, prioritizing those with smaller increases

summary: DecDEC augments quantized LLM decoding with dynamic error compensation fetched from CPU memory, and must tune two per-layer parameters (n_tb, k_chunk) to hit a target slowdown. This figure works through DecDEC's tuner for a 56-SM GPU with a 10% target slowdown. Phase 1 runs a coarse-grained k_chunk search for every candidate n_tb^max from 1 to 28 and keeps the one allowing the most valid steps; panel (b) shows this search for n_tb^max=24, incrementing all four projection layers' k_chunk together until Step 20's summed latency finally exceeds the target (a cross replaces the checkmarks that mark Steps 0-19 as valid). Phase 2 then runs a fine-grained search on that winner: panel (c) zooms into the same n_tb^max=24 case and, at each step, increments as many individual layers as it can, in the order (circled ①②③④) of smallest latency cost, yielding the final per-layer k_chunk values shown in the Result table.
summary_zh: 该图展示DecDEC在56个SM、目标降速10%下的调优：阶段一对每个候选n_tb^max做粗粒度k_chunk搜索取步数最多者；阶段二对其做细粒度搜索，按延迟增量用序号①②③④递增各层k_chunk，得到最终结果。
